comparison.objective: Rod out a blocked drain without kinking the drain rod; body and specs are absent.
comparison.physical_skill: Feed, rotate, and regulate axial/bending loads on a long flexible rod, unlike rigid mandrel hammering and fragment pickup.
comparison.success_condition: Blockage removal without rod kinking is implied; flow, insertion-depth, force, and damage thresholds are missing.
comparison.reason: Tests compliant-tool navigation and blockage clearing, not manufactured-notch fracture or recovery of detached tangs.
